comments.author: Marco Reyes
comments.body: Staging SPA load test no longer 429s on preflight-heavy bursts. Waiting on one more review before prod.

content.text: Staging SPA load test no longer 429s on preflight-heavy bursts. Waiting on one more review before prod.

CORS preflight OPTIONS requests count against the same rate-limit quota as the real API calls. Browser apps that preflight frequently burn through the client's budget before the meaningful methods run.

Expected: OPTIONS for CORS is exempt from application quota (or billed to a separate generous bucket). Actual: each preflight decrements the same redis counter keyed by API token, so a chatty SPA can 429 on GET after a burst of OPTIONS alone.

Hypothesis: the rate-limit middleware runs before the CORS short-circuit, so OPTIONS never hits the bypass branch that skips quota for health checks. Method allowlisting for quota exemption omits OPTIONS.
Browser integrations look flaky under load tests even when server-side call volume is modest.
